overall: Item numbers in comments are 1-based. The checker is clean (284/284) and most items are sound general knowledge. The main problems are leaks and duplicates. Leaks: several items rest on facts that COVID coverage made famous, so a COVID-aware reader has an edge: corona/coronavirus = crown, coronaviruses are respiratory RNA viruses, CoV = coronavirus, SARS = ...Syndrome, Omicron after Xi and as a Greek letter, Wuhan in Hubei and as a transport hub, WHO declaring a pandemic, asymptomatic, endemic, whom a mask protects, the vaccine cold chain. Duplicates: the same facts recur across tokens (1918 Spanish flu 5x, Black Death rats 3x, antibiotics-not-for-viruses 3x, epidemic-vs-pandemic 3x, antivirus quarantine 3x, dogs/rabies 4x, CDC = US/Atlanta twice, MERS camels twice, EBV twice). Each fact should appear once. 'demic' should be exclusive: only infodemic, plandemic and tripledemic (all COVID-era) and the obscure zoodemic split to it. Forced wording to hit the token needs rework: COVENTRY/COVALENT in caps, CapsLock, quoted "Infielder" and "Bolsonaro", "Sarsens", "abbreviated (SARS)", "non-pandemic", "under quarantines". Natural alternatives checked with the tokenizer: 'the COV of a sample', pro-/anti-Bolsonaro, lowercase ' pandemics' for 'demics'. A few items are giveaways (lock+down, un-, viral<-virus) or too obscure for a 2B model (infecund, archaic Trump = trumpet, the Apollo trailer, counting Greek letters).
